capabilities: Render vega and vega-lite code blocks as charts
Create bar, line, and scatter plots from JSON specifications
Customize visualizations via Vega/Vega-Lite spec syntax
extras: The README links to the Vega and Vega-Lite websites for specification formatting details and credits the University of Washington Interactive Data Lab under the BSD 3-Clause license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render data visualizations like line, bar, or scatter charts from data specifications.
summary: Renders Vega and Vega-Lite charts from JSON specifications in vega/vega-lite code blocks inside notes.
